name: com.shivang.crm.modules.auth.AuthModule
comment: Auth Module marker configuration.  This class serves as the module boundary marker for Spring Modulith. All auth-related beans (controllers, services, repositories, security filters) are organized under this package.  Module responsibilities: - User authentication (login/logout) - JWT access token generation & validation - Refresh token rotation & storage - Tenant context resolution from JWT claims - Token blacklist (Redis) for logout invalidation - Password management

methods.name: register
methods.comment: POST /api/v1/auth/register Register a new user and create a tenant.

methods.name: login
methods.comment: POST /api/v1/auth/login Authenticate, return access token in body + set refresh cookie.

methods.name: refresh
methods.comment: POST /api/v1/auth/refresh Get new access token using refresh cookie. Implements token rotation.

methods.name: logout
methods.comment: POST /api/v1/auth/logout Revoke refresh token, blacklist access token in Redis.

methods.name: changePassword
methods.comment: POST /api/v1/auth/change-password Authenticated user changes password. Invalidates all other sessions.

methods.name: me
methods.comment: GET /api/v1/auth/me Get current authenticated user info.

name: com.shivang.crm.modules.auth.dto.request.RefreshTokenRequest
comment: Placeholder DTO for refresh token requests. The actual refresh token is read from the HTTP-only cookie, not from the request body.

name: com.shivang.crm.modules.auth.security.CustomUserDetailsService
comment: Custom UserDetailsService that loads users by email. Used by Spring Security for authentication.

name: com.shivang.crm.modules.auth.security.JwtAuthenticationFilter
comment: JWT Authentication Filter — first in the security filter chain. Per SKILL-04: validates token signature + expiry, extracts claims, checks Redis blacklist, and sets SecurityContext.

methods.name: generateAccessToken
methods.comment: Generate an access token with user_id, tenant_id, and role_id claims. Per SKILL-04: NO permissions in JWT — only identifiers.

methods.name: parseToken
methods.comment: Validate and parse the JWT. Returns claims if valid, throws on failure.

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.comment: Check if the token is valid (signature + not expired).

methods.name: getRemainingExpirySeconds
methods.comment: Get remaining seconds until token expiry. Used for Redis blacklist TTL during logout.

name: com.shivang.crm.modules.auth.security.TenantContext
comment: Request-scoped holder for current tenant and user context. Set by TenantResolutionFilter on every authenticated request. Cleared after request completes to prevent memory leaks.

name: com.shivang.crm.modules.auth.security.TenantResolutionFilter
comment: Tenant Resolution Filter — runs AFTER JwtAuthenticationFilter. Per SKILL-02 + SKILL-04: extracts tenant_id from JWT claim and sets it in TenantContext (ThreadLocal).  Filter chain order: JwtAuthFilter → TenantResolutionFilter → Controller

name: com.shivang.crm.modules.auth.security.TokenBlacklistService
comment: Redis-backed token blacklist for logout invalidation. When a user logs out, their access token is blacklisted in Redis with a TTL matching the token's remaining lifetime.

methods.name: clearRefreshCookie
